answer: The umber schedule is applied in shale and anchor exposes each instalment. A payout is split thus 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4879 identities would post 3031 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
